title: Master_IP_Assignment_Agreement.pdf
overview: Master Intellectual Property Assignment, Non-Competition, and Mutual Indemnification Agreement between Apex Global Systems Inc. and Dr. Robert C. Vance assigning algorithmic document parsing technology.
highlights: Section 1.1: Absolute assignment of worldwide patents, algorithms, trade secrets, and moral rights.
Section 2.1: 24-month restrictive non-compete restricted to North America and EU markets.
Section 4.1: Mutual indemnification capped at $1,500,000 direct damages.
actionNote: Section 4.3 requires formal written notice of any third-party claim within 14 calendar days of receipt.

title: Inpatient_Discharge_Cardiology.pdf
overview: Hospital discharge summary for 64-year-old male admitted with non-ST elevation myocardial infarction (NSTEMI) status-post successful drug-eluting stent placement to the Left Anterior Descending (LAD) coronary artery.
highlights: Hemodynamics: Discharged stable with normal baseline ECG and preserved left ventricular ejection fraction of 52%.
Pharmacology: Dual antiplatelet therapy prescribed (Aspirin 81 mg daily + Ticagrelor 90 mg BID) with Atorvastatin 80 mg daily.
Allergies & Contraindications: Severe Penicillin allergy (anaphylaxis/hives); all NSAIDs strictly contraindicated.
actionNote: Report immediately to Emergency if chest pressure persists >5 minutes or signs of bleeding occur. Cardiology clinic visit in 10 days.
